narrative.intro: Airbus Us Space and Defense obligated $253M in FY2026 to date. Obligations fell 22.6% year over year. Airbus Us Space and Defense received 8 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $31.6M. The Department of Defense is the principal buyer, obligating $253M. Other buying agencies with recorded obligations are the Department of Justice with $156K and the Department of Homeland Security with $12.5K. The largest market by NAICS is Other Support Activities for Air Transportation at $253M. Historical obligations show $220M in FY21, $255M in FY22, $356M in FY23, $348M in FY24, and $327M in FY25, followed by the current-year total of $253M. Smaller recorded markets include Computer and Computer Peripheral Equipment and Software Merchant Wholesalers at $156K, Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing at $12.5K, and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences at $500.
